source.note: The tag points at the release commit on release/0.66.0. `origin/main` sits on a separate lineage (its own 0.65.0 commits, receipt ac9f5cd); this branch is neither ahead nor behind it in a fast-forward sense, and main was deliberately not rewritten. See divergence.

divergence.finding: Local tag v0.65.0 pointed at c611013, while origin/main carries the published 0.65.0 as 879c7b2 plus receipt ac9f5cd. The working branch archive/preview6 is 108 commits ahead of origin/main and 93 behind it, so this release is not an ancestor-consistent continuation of main.
divergence.decision: Released from release/0.66.0 (a branch off the verified working tree) and documented here rather than rewriting history. The published artifact is byte-verified; main still shows the earlier lineage.
followUp: Decide whether main should be fast-forwarded to release/0.66.0 or reconciled with a merge commit; both are visible, public changes to the default branch and were left to the owner.
The stale local tag v0.65.0 (c611013) does not match the GitHub release for 0.65.0. It should be deleted locally or re-pointed after that decision.

notVerified: No install into the user's live desktop profile; the plugin was not mounted in a running Host after publication.
No Windows installer or durable remote-agent package was rebuilt; Remote Agent stays 0.1.1.
GitLab mirror was not pushed in this round.
GitHub rendering of the release notes and README math requires the published page, not a local check.
